name: Best Western Rewards Premium

apr.notes: 25.99% to 29.99% variable APR based on Prime Rate. Minimum interest charge $1.50. Balance transfer fee 4% or $5 min. Cash advance fee 5% or $10 min. Accurate as of 12/31/2025.

credit_required.notes: Not explicitly stated. Mercury Financial focuses on credit-building/broader accessibility. Prequalification available without hard pull. Bonus offer varies by prequalification.

base_rate.description: 2 BWR Points per $1 on all other purchases

categories.label: Gas station and grocery store purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: BWR Points redeemable only through Best Western Rewards program. Redemptions start at 5,000 points and vary by location and date of stay. Points posted to linked BWR Account monthly (allow 30 days after billing cycle).

signup_bonus.description: Up to 80,000 BWR Points after spending $3,000 in first 90 days. Actual bonus and spend requirement shown before applying via prequalification tool. Pay with Points value = $400.

benefits.title: Automatic Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Platinum Elite status in BWR Program as long as Card Account remains open and in Good Standing. Allow 30 days after account opening.

benefits.title: Anniversary Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award each 12-month period after becoming a cardmember and after payment of annual fee. Redeemable at any Best Western branded hotel in US, Canada, or Caribbean. Valid 1 year after issue.

benefits.title: Free Night Award with Qualifying Spend
benefits.description: Additional Free Night Award each 12-month period after $10,000 in Net Purchases. Up to two Free Night Awards total per year.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside the US.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Reimbursement
benefits.description: Trip cancellation and interruption reimbursement included.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Platinum Elite status in Best Western Rewards program
other: Up to two Free Night Awards each anniversary (one after annual fee, one after $10,000 spend)

notes: Issuer changed from FNBO to First Bank & Trust, Brookings, SD (managed by Mercury Financial) in Aug 2024. FNBO no longer issues this card. The bestwestern.com page is the only official product/application page (no standalone First Bank & Trust public page). Visa Signature.
